title: WebView JavaScript bridge (java)
description: Android code in java exposes a Java object to web content with webView.addJavascriptInterface. Any page loaded in that WebView can call the exposed methods, so content from a remote origin can reach native code. This lexical rule flags the registration; the reviewer confirms the WebView only loads trusted content or switches to a @JavascriptInterface allowlist on first-party pages.
remediation: Remove the bridge, or expose only @JavascriptInterface methods on a reviewed allowlist to WebViews that load first-party content.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the registration call. Whether the WebView loads remote content is not analysed.
